item.title: Self-Hosted Code Linters & Formatters: ESLint vs Prettier vs Ruff vs Black vs RuboCop
item.description: Consistent code style and early bug detection are the bedrock of maintainable software. Linters catch potential bugs, enforce best practices, and flag security vulnerabilities before they reach code review. Formatters eliminate bikeshedding over tabs vs spaces, quote styles, and line wrapping — freeing your team to focus on architecture and logic instead of formatting preferences.
